audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits: Syndra owns the pre-6 range war (50.41% WR, 3061 games), Ekko threatens post-6 with W-shield-stun all-ins and Chronobreak resets. Diff and tone consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side reads 'Ekko' while content win[4] is 'Syndra', the phase why describes Syndra winning (Unleashed Power execute), whys[4] says your E peels his all-in, and the packet levelChart is Syndra on all seven rows. Two layers disagreed on Level 6.
audit.why: regression-check fails a champion whose layers disagree; the why and content both back Syndra, so side moves to match win[4].
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Syndra (win[4] already Syndra, so side edits alone per the chart rule).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers. Three verified interactions absent: Chronobreak heals a percentage of damage taken (Grievous Wounds timing), Parallel Convergence shields him inside the anomaly (force it before committing burst), and Phase Dive is an auto-reset — the wind-up is the step-back cue. Two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: All three are in Riot's own ability text in the kit file plus the missingInteractions list.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added (R 110/50, W 22s, E 9s vs your 15s); antiheal folded into itemization; shield folded into enemyWin; auto-reset tell folded into dosFull[1].d.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Ekko wins by eating your burst with his W shield-stun, then Chronobreak restarts the fight your kit already spent.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Check it before every step-up. - E Scatter the Weak is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1, 50s at rank 3 — erases your kill and bursts back; save final damage for after the hologram. - His W Parallel Convergence is 22s: forced out, his stun-shield all-in is gone. - E Scatter the Weak is the lifeline; chip never gets it.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: His combo opens with the Phase Dive roll and an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue: E him back before the blink lands.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: His E is 9s to your 15 — chase past your stun and the next Phase Dive lands with nothing to answer it; reset and poke instead.
